name: GCSE Chemistry (AQA 8462) — separate science, Foundation and Higher tier

selected_options.tiers_built: Both Foundation and Higher, consistent with the other GCSE sciences and Mathematics
selected_options.pathway_note: This is the separate-science route (full Chemistry GCSE, 8462), distinct from the Chemistry content within Combined Science: Trilogy. It includes Chemistry-only content such as titration calculations, atom economy, gas volumes, organic chemistry, chemical analysis, the atmosphere, using resources and the Haber process.

material_vintage: AQA GCSE Chemistry (8462) specification (first teaching 2016, current and live). Every subject-content code 4.1.1.1-4.10.4.2, the 8 required practicals, Working scientifically WS1-WS4 (section 3) and the Mathematical requirements (section 7) were itemised on 2026-09-19 from AQA's own specification pages and PDF. Stage test scenarios are original questions written in the style of AQA papers, not real past-paper items.
level_source: RQF Level 2 (GCSE, full grade range 1-9 / Foundation+Higher tiers covered), per Ofqual's Register of Regulated Qualifications listing for this specification
